items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 9 at 1:45AM EDT until October 10 at 12:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...Coastal Collier County, Mainland Monroe, Coastal
Broward County, Coastal Miami Dade County and Far South Miami-
Dade County.

* WHEN...Through Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 9 at 1:43AM EDT until October 10 at 4:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds around 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and
seas 5 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL out
20 NM and Waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL from 20
to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 8 AM this morning to 4 PM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
